title: Bad bg readings block the loop
body:
Hi, I have some problems with eversense and esel, I use mm640 as a driver in aaps last dev. I don't use xdrip for other problems due to readings that often arrive every 2 minutes and make the trend arrows on nightscout go crazy. While esel is perfect but sometimes causes the problem you can see in the photo. Obviously I use bg companion mode as a reading. Would it be possible to limit aaps to not accept bg data less than 3/4 minutes? Thanks

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/46341578-d709-4076-a5d3-9260ae002b38)
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3596691-b043-4c69-8327-2b14847122d0)

comments.body: This must be rosolved on esel side. AAPS is designed to trust BG source
